nodes.label: IntentDetector (total function)
nodes.rationale: No abstention or threshold; argmax over five banking labels, root cause of several misrouting defects.

nodes.label: DialogueManager
nodes.rationale: Deterministic control layer; AI does not own workflow state, DialogueManager makes final state-change decisions.

nodes.label: Tier 1 Deterministic Command Routing
nodes.rationale: Runs before intent detection and before any LLM call so control commands are reliable.

nodes.label: Phase 3.2A Acknowledgement Routing
nodes.rationale: Fixes 'Thank you' starting a loan workflow; acknowledgement is not completion, resume, or exit.

nodes.label: Rejection of Global Confidence Threshold
nodes.rationale: Non-banking closing (0.321) and legit request (0.325) differ by 0.004; scores are English-calibrated and would reject Kannada/Hindi.

nodes.label: Polite Control Wrapper Stripping (classify_polite_control)
nodes.rationale: Wrapper + known phrase only, never fuzzy; limited to pause/resume/repeat because cancel/next fail unsafe.

nodes.label: Negation Protection (contains_negation)
nodes.rationale: Stripping could turn a refusal into a command; refusing a genuine command costs one turn, executing a refused one costs the request.

nodes.label: coerce_step_number
nodes.rationale: bool subclass of int would silently read back step 1; schema is a request not a guarantee.

nodes.label: Information-Response Honesty
nodes.rationale: Receipt only when an entity was actually stored.

nodes.label: Resting-State Control Guard
nodes.rationale: A control classification can never reach IntentDetector.

nodes.label: Explicit Step Reference Routing (classify_step_reference)
nodes.rationale: Step content is read from workflow definition, never generated; read-only in every state.

nodes.label: target_workflow Understanding Field
nodes.rationale: Top-level, not in entities, because entities are customer-supplied values persisted by add_entities.

nodes.label: RecentSideQuestion Bounded Context
nodes.rationale: Exactly one exchange retained structurally; session-local on ConversationManager for multi-session safety.

nodes.label: Three-Valued Completion Resolution (resolve_step_completion)
nodes.rationale: Completion was the only workflow signal with no deterministic component; None defers to LLM so it corrects rather than replaces.

nodes.label: Domain Terminology Normalizer
nodes.rationale: Fixes Whisper mis-transcriptions like 'Chuck Book' -> cheque book; 'load'->'loan' deliberately excluded.

nodes.label: restate_current_step
nodes.rationale: Shared phrasing so deterministic and LLM paths cannot drift.

hyperedges.label: Deterministic routing tiers that run before IntentDetector
